name: Railhook Cloud Free
watch_out: Railhook Cloud Free is hosted, distinct from the MIT-licensed self-hosted edition (which has no plan quotas but requires your own infrastructure). Cloud limits also include 10 event ingestions/second/project, 5 members/organization, 1 active tunnel and at most 100 deliveries per event. Requests beyond the monthly 10,000-event quota are rejected with quota_exceeded (HTTP 402); previously accepted events are still delivered/retried. Cloud commercial-use terms remain unconfirmed.
